pages.text: The $(item)Echo Resonator$() came out of the altar. It turns the city's own screams into Corruption.

pages.name: Echo Resonator
pages.text: A 5 by 5 floor, a sculk shrieker on each corner.

pages.title: The Round
pages.text: I feed it ender pearls, or eyes of ender when I have them. It throws one through a small rift and it flies from shrieker to shrieker, and each one it passes screams Corruption into the nearest awake altar.$(br2)A pearl breaks 45 times in a hundred at each shrieker. An eye, only 15.

pages.title: The Third Tier
pages.text: Its last tier wanted more than things. It wanted a warden killed within sixteen blocks of it. The rift took the body, laid it on a table, and a crystal tore out its heart.$(br2)No pearl since. All four shriekers draw on that heart at once, every second and a half.
